items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC-1..AC-9 each map to at least one assertion; nothing outside the card's two decided gaps was implemented. Detail in self_review.md.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: defer raises the same three exception types as dismiss and _status_flip maps all three to the exit-2 arm dismiss already used; every rejection path asserts the store is byte-unchanged.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Fixed during review: scalar fields reused the payload sanitizer, which keeps \n by design, so a stored reason could forge listing rows. Now strip_control_chars_inline, a sibling in tty_sanitize.py so the policy cannot fork.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Outcome assertions (resolved item, stored bytes, exit code, stdout); CLI cases run the real script as a subprocess; no skips, no loosened assertions; cap padding measured from a probe, not a magic number.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: _cmd_list still makes one pass over the resolved items; _cap_detail is an O(1) length check.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Two extractions, both forced by the 300-line budget: lib/triage_render.py and _decide_from_triage/_require_store. Every touched file inside budget (249/298/92/220/133/275).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Three, all in the spec. list --json is pinned byte-for-byte by a WebUI fixture and stays open-only, asserted with a deferred item present. No new stored format: snoozed was already in triage.STATUSES.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: No pytest.skip, no environment-conditional assertion, no xfail; both new files are self-contained under tmp_path and cross no plugin boundary.
